verdict.rationale: Background automation is a fair axis for an infrastructure-automation product, but the evidence shows no recurring schedule, trigger, or background-run feature. `-auto-approve` only makes a single apply non-interactive; it does not set up a schedule. JSON output and MCP workspace run management are building blocks an external scheduler or CI system would need to orchestrate, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
